claim: This video shows moments before the October 2026 train crash in Urda, Spain.
caption:
CLAIM: A circulating clip shows the moments before the October 2026 train crash in Urda, Spain.

EVIDENCE: Lead Stories found the same passenger footage in a Facebook post dated 2 February 2020. Its caption described a swaying Alvia train journey from Huelva to Madrid—more than six years before the crash. The misleading post circulated on 28 October 2026.

VERDICT: Old footage, falsely linked to a new event.

This check concerns the video's provenance only—not casualty totals, responsibility, earlier warnings or accident rankings.

Source: Lead Stories, 29 October 2026
https://leadstories.com/hoax-alert/2026/10/fact-check-video-does-not-show-moments-before-2026-train-crash-in-urda-spain-was-originally-posted-in-2020.html

AI illustration — not actual footage. The artwork is symbolic and does not reconstruct the crash.

#FactCheck #ClaimVsEvidence #MediaLiteracy

Checked 30 October 2026. AI-assisted research, design and original illustration; independent automated review.
